text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I stroll around the academy, I spot Seeking the Pearl completely absorbed in a dance.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant… Th-that's it! My heart… is rac—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
choice_data_list: Are you okay? You shouldn't overwork yourself!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I know… I shouldn't. I'm still tired from my race, but…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm the precious pearl who reveals possibilities to the world! It's my duty to stir people's hearts through my dance!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I need to up the beat even more! Go away, fatigue and exhaustion! No one needs you here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl is as enthusiastic as ever, but she seems worn out from her races. I'll need to rethink her upcoming race schedule.
